exposure: Previous spontaneous preterm delivery (sPTD) or Preterm Premature Rupture of Membranes (PPROM)
cohort: Asymptomatic pregnant women between 16 and 24 weeks' gestation with at least one clinical risk factor for spontaneous preterm delivery or a cervical length less than 2.5 cm.
finding: TVS Cervical strain elastography (CSE), specifically lower strain ratios, was a significant independent predictor of spontaneous preterm delivery (sPTD) and performed better than cervical length, although its overall predictive efficacy was modest.
